import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
d = df.dropna(subset=['recovery_score']+exposures).copy()
print("n used", len(d))
X_site = pd.get_dummies(d['hospital'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
for e in exposures:
    X = pd.concat([d[[e]].astype(float), X_site], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(d['recovery_score'], X).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={m.params[e]:8.4f} se={m.bse[e]:7.4f} p={m.pvalues[e]:.4g}")
